document.dispatch_duplicate: {name} already had this document — no duplicate created

ot.alarm: Sensor {name} read {value} °C, above the {threshold} °C threshold — draft created by the system

inbox.title: My tasks
inbox.subtitle: Tasks waiting for you — urgent first

receive.title: Receive an incoming document
receive.subtitle: Upload the electronic copy, enter the document details, then register.
receive.drop: Drop a PDF or image here, or click to choose
receive.restrictedHint: Only the receiver and people granted access can read it. PDF only, stored encrypted; every view is stamped with the viewer’s name
receive.duplicate: This document may already be received: {symbol} from {issuer}, dated {date}.
receive.dropRestricted: Drop PDF files here, or click to choose — files are encrypted before they are stored
receive.pdfOnly: Restricted documents accept PDF files only
receive.restrictedLocked: Remove the uploaded files to change the restricted setting

doc.historyHint: From the audit log: who changed what, and when. Content fields (summary, file names…) only show that they changed.
doc.registerConfirm: Register this document? The number is assigned automatically, consecutively per year.
doc.notFound: Document not found, or you are not allowed to see it.
doc.submitHint: The department head reviews first, then the signer. If returned, the draft comes back to you.
doc.submitted: Submitted. Waiting for the department head.
doc.sealedHint: Stored encrypted. Downloads are stamped with the viewer’s name and every opening is written to the audit log
doc.viewersHint: Only the receiver and the people listed below can read this document. Whoever must handle the next step is added automatically; people added still need the usual role-based access (department, assigned work).
doc.viewerRevoked: {name} can no longer read this document

dispatch.title: Dispatch within the system
dispatch.plannedHint: Once issued, the document goes straight to the clerks of the units below, with the issued PDF.
dispatch.sentHint: The document goes straight to each unit’s clerk with the issued PDF; they register and handle it like any incoming document.
dispatch.duplicateHint: The receiving unit had already registered this document, so no duplicate was created.
dispatch.hashMismatch: SHA-256 does NOT match the sender’s issued copy — report it to the administrator
dispatch.fromHint: An outgoing document of another unit on Mộc, delivered here when the sender issued it. The file is a copy of the issued PDF; open the verification page to compare.
dispatch.manualHint: The clerk registered this document from paper or email; the sender's in-system dispatch arrived later and was only linked, so the attached file is the one the clerk uploaded. Open the verification page to compare it with the issued copy.

duyet.returnNote: Say why it is returned and what to change

phatHanh.public: Show the subject on the public verification page
phatHanh.publicHint: If unchecked, only the number, date and issuer are shown.
phatHanh.restricted: Restricted document: the verification page shows only number, date and issuer — the summary is never public.
phatHanh.confirm: Assign the next outgoing number and issue this document? Numbers are sequential per year and cannot be taken back.

search.title: Search documents
search.placeholder: Reference, summary, issuer, PDF text — diacritics optional
search.matchedContentHint: The words appear in the document body or in the text of an attached PDF, not in its reference or summary

error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
error.session: Your session has expired, redirecting to sign in…
error.documents_in_dedup: This document was already received (same issuer, reference and date).
error.documents_due_after_registered: The deadline cannot be before the registration date.
error.infected: The file contains malware and was blocked.
error.unscannable: The file is password-protected or nested too deeply for the malware scanner to check — blocked. Remove the password or unpack it, then upload again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.noRole: Your account has no role or unit yet. Contact your unit administrator.
error.documents_body_length: The body is longer than 20,000 characters.
error.invalid: Some fields are not valid, see the highlighted fields.
error.document_files_sealed: Restricted documents only take files uploaded in restricted mode (encrypted), and encrypted files only go to restricted documents
error.documents_restricted_sealed: This document already has files, so its restricted setting cannot change
error.documents_restricted_local: Restricted documents cannot be sent to other units within the system.
error.documents_recipient_units: Invalid receiving unit (unknown, or your own unit), or the document was already submitted so its receiving units can no longer change.

validation.not: Extra spaces at the start or end, line breaks or hidden characters
validation.nfc: Text is not in composed Unicode form (NFC)
validation.year: The year must be between 1900 and 2099
validation.uniqueItems: The same file is attached twice
validation.duplicate: An incoming document with the same issuer, number and date already exists
validation.unknown: Not found, or not uploaded by you
validation.not_sealed: Restricted documents only take files uploaded in restricted mode — remove and upload again
validation.sealed: Encrypted files are for restricted documents only — remove and upload again
validation.restricted: Restricted documents never publish their summary

compose.title: Draft an outgoing document
compose.subtitle: The text is typeset as a PDF following Decree 30/2020; the clerk assigns the number and date when issuing.
compose.attachmentsHint: Annexes or tables (optional); files are virus-scanned before they are stored
compose.notEditable: This draft can no longer be edited: it was submitted, or you are not its author.
compose.unitsHint: Once issued, the document goes straight to the clerks of the selected units, with the issued PDF. Ticking a unit adds its name to the recipients.
compose.unitsRestricted: Restricted documents are not sent to other units: their files can only be opened in your own unit.

verify.title: Verify a document
verify.subtitle: Check that a document issued through Mộc is genuine and unaltered.
verify.codeHint: 10 characters printed next to the QR code, e.g. ABCDE-23456
verify.file: Or drop the PDF you received here
verify.fileHint: The file never leaves your computer: your browser computes its SHA-256 and only the hash is sent.
verify.valid: Genuine document, issued by the organisation below
verify.notFoundHint: Check the code. When checking a file: it was altered, or it was not issued through Mộc.
verify.match: The file matches the issued copy byte for byte
verify.mismatch: The file does NOT match the document with this code: it may have been altered
verify.compare: Drop the PDF you received to compare it with the original
verify.noCrypto: This browser cannot compute SHA-256 (HTTPS required). Look up by code instead.
verify.rateLimited: Too many lookups. Wait a minute and try again.
verify.footer: Mộc — open-source e-office. No login required on this page.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.offline: Live channel not connected — existing notifications are still shown, reconnecting
notify.otAlarm: Temperature alert in {name}: {value} °C — incident report draft ready

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every data change in your organisation, linked into a SHA-256 hash chain: editing or deleting a row in secret is detected.
audit.anchored: The chain is anchored outside the database up to row #{id}, at {at}.
audit.notAnchored: The chain has not been anchored outside the database yet.
audit.how: Each anchor copies the hash of the newest row to write-locked storage that nobody can delete or change, administrators included. Server administrators check the whole chain with make audit.
audit.hiddenHint: The log does not show these values, so restricted documents stay private

file.unscannable: Blocked unscannable file (password, nested too deeply)

register.title: Document registers
register.subtitle: The columns of the statutory register template (Decree 30/2020/NĐ-CP, Appendix IV). Print on paper for signatures and the year-end closing.
register.none: The {year} register has no documents yet.
register.gaps: Rows missing for numbers: {numbers}. Tell your system administrator before printing.
register.how: Click a row to open the document. The Signature and Copies columns stay blank for handwriting on the printout. Every print is recorded in the audit log.
register.masked: {n} rows are restricted documents you cannot read: only number, dates and reference are shown.

board.title: Overview
board.subtitle: Document figures for your unit, computed when the page opens. Counts only; restricted documents appear as a single total, not broken down by status or department.
board.forbidden: Only unit leaders can view this page.
board.overdueHint: Not finished (including awaiting registration) and past the deadline
board.avgHint: From registration to done, last 12 months · {done} documents
board.noneDone: No document has been finished yet
board.byDepartment: Incoming in progress by lead department
board.onTimePct: {pct}% on time (of those with a deadline)
board.restricted: {n} restricted documents are left out of the breakdowns on this page, so nobody can infer their status.
